title: POST /api/v1/encounter/ returns HTTP 500 for external_identifier longer than 100 characters
steps: Log in as care-doctor (synthetic fixture account).
POST /api/v1/encounter/ with a valid payload and external_identifier = 'X' * 101.
expected: HTTP 400 with a validation message (the database column is varchar(100)).
actual: HTTP 500, django.db.utils.DataError: value too long for type character varying(100). A 100-character value returns 200.
evidence: API-ENC-014; live re-run 28 Nov 2026; testing/evidence/endpoint-weaknesses.md (EW-01); RCA-2 in docs/defects/rca.md

title: PUT /api/v1/encounter/{id}/ returns HTTP 500 when hospitalization is null
triage: Report upstream - reject null or coerce it to {} in the spec
steps: PUT /api/v1/encounter/{id}/ for an open encounter with hospitalization: null.
expected: HTTP 400, or null treated as an empty object.
actual: HTTP 500 IntegrityError (NOT NULL on emr_encounter.hospitalization). Record unchanged.
evidence: API-ENC-024; live re-run 28 Nov 2026; EW-02; RCA-2

title: Backend accepts a non-planned encounter with a future start date (BR-ENC-02 only enforced in the browser)
triage: Report upstream - add the BR-ENC-02 check to server-side create validation
steps: POST /api/v1/encounter/ with status 'in_progress' and period.start = tomorrow.
expected: HTTP 400 'Future date is only allowed for planned encounters' (the UI blocks this input).
actual: HTTP 200; the encounter is stored as in_progress with a future start.
evidence: Live API check 28 Nov 2026 (record cancelled afterwards); UI rejection in testing/e2e/specs/encounter-e2e.spec.ts; RCA-1

title: Create Encounter: time input has no accessible name and the BR-ENC-02 error is not linked to the field
steps: Run axe-core, or inspect the time input with a screen reader.
expected: Input named 'Date and Time'; aria-invalid and aria-describedby set when the rule rejects the value.
actual: Before fix: no name (axe 'label', critical); no aria-invalid/describedby.

title: Date-picker calendar icon is an unnamed role=img
expected: Decorative icon hidden from assistive technology.
actual: axe svg-img-alt (serious) on svg.care-l-calender.

title: Encounter screen has an empty span[role=button] sheet trigger with no accessible name
expected: Every focusable control has a name.
actual: aria-command-name on span[data-slot=sheet-trigger] (axe serious + Lighthouse).

title: Quick-action accessible names do not contain their visible text
expected: Accessible name starts with the visible label (WCAG 2.5.3).
actual: e.g. visible 'Symptoms', name 'Add Symptom' (8 controls).

title: Encounter status dot uses aria-label on a plain div
expected: Status available to assistive technology.
actual: aria-prohibited-attr on div[aria-label='Planned'] (EncounterCard.tsx:53-58).

title: Tab moves focus outside the Create Encounter dialog after Submit
expected: Focus stays inside the modal.
actual: After Submit, focus moves to a span outside the dialog, then returns to Close.

title: Missing encounter type shows only 'Required'
expected: A message that names the field and the action.
actual: 'Required'.

title: Hidden sr-only duplicate 'Mark as Completed' button
steps: Open an encounter screen with a screen reader.
expected: One 'Mark as Completed' control.
actual: An extra sr-only, tabIndex -1 button (EncounterShow.tsx:262-268).

title: Encounter screen requests /account/default_account/ and gets 400 on every load
expected: No failing request when no billing account is configured.
actual: GET .../account/default_account/ -> 400 (Lighthouse errors-in-console).

title: JWTs stored in localStorage and production CSP is report-only
steps: Inspect localStorage and the nginx config.
expected: Tokens not readable by page script; enforced CSP.
actual: care_access_token and care_refresh_token in localStorage; Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only.

title: Backend dependencies with published advisories (Django 6.0, DRF 3.16.1, PyJWT 2.12.0, authlib, Pillow, urllib3, cryptography)
triage: Report upstream - upgrade after team approval
steps: pip-audit on the installed backend packages.
expected: No known advisories.
actual: 119 unique advisories in 8 packages (7 Critical, 54 High).

title: Local settings allow any CORS origin and any host
triage: Won't fix - local development settings only
expected: Allow-list.
actual: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

title: Mutation campaign never produced a mutmut score (local and CI)
expected: Mutation score.
actual: 'failed to collect stats. runner returned 1' - score null.

title: Complete-encounter E2E test clicked a hidden shortcut button through JavaScript
expected: Test uses the user-visible control.
actual: element.click() on a 2x2px sr-only button.
evidence: Current spec uses the Actions-panel button

title: testing/README.md backend test command used the wrong PYTHONPATH
expected: Tests run.
actual: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'care_testing'.
evidence: Reproduced 28 Nov 2026; README now uses PYTHONPATH=/tmp:/app (as CI)

title: Encounter list filter live=true returns only completed/cancelled encounters (the "Live" view shows ended encounters)
triage: Report upstream - invert LiveFilter (live=true -> exclude COMPLETED_CHOICES); upstream test test_filters_by_live_as_true currently asserts the inverted behaviour
expected: live=true lists open (in-progress/planned/on-hold) encounters, as the frontend EncounterList sends live=true for its "live" status (EncounterList.tsx:129-130).
actual: live=true -> 200 completed/cancelled only; live=false -> open only (LiveFilter in emr/api/viewsets/encounter.py:57-66).
evidence: Live API check 28 Nov 2026; 13 LiveFilter mutants survive because killing them would require asserting the defective behaviour (testing/evidence/mutation-analysis.md)

title: Unhandled (floating) promises from queryClient.invalidateQueries in the create and complete flows
triage: Fix now - mark fire-and-forget invalidations with void (testing/sonar/care_fe-floating-promises-fix.patch), delivered through a pull request
steps: Run SonarQube (testing/sonar/sonar-gate.sh) on the scoped modules.
expected: Reliability rating A (no bugs).
actual: 5 x typescript:S9383 (CreateEncounterForm.tsx:197; useEncounterProgressController.ts:34,41,44,45); Reliability rating C; quality gate FAILED.
